profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Analytical and creative problem solver with consulting and corporate experience.  Full stack Java development and integration of large e-commerce web sites with backend systems and third-party providers.  Experienced in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Ecommerce Development, Java, JEE, Software Engineering, Business IT liaison,  Web Systems Integration,  Analysis & Design

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Project Estimation · iWay · Angular · Web Applications · PL/SQL · Java

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building business solutions by creating new and modifying existing software applications.   A primary contributor in designing, coding, testing, debugging, documenting and supporting all types of applications consistent with the established specifications and business requirements in order to deliver business value. 

Primary Responsibilities:
Designing, coding, testing, debugging, documenting and supporting all types of applications consistent with established specifications and business requirements to deliver business value
Developing pioneering approaches to emerging industry trends
Leads large, complex projects to achieve key business objectives
Collaborate with the team on application architecture design and decision-making
Develop innovative solutions to meet the needs of the business
Provide alternate design solutions along with project estimates
Design and implement application enhancements in collaboration with different teams
Troubleshoot and solve complex production issues
Predict emerging customer needs and develops innovative solutions to meet them
Solves unique and complex problems with broad impact on the business
Participates in the development of business strategy
Translates highly complex concepts in ways that can be understood by a variety of audiences
Influences senior leadership to adopt new ideas, products, and / or approaches
Function as a mentor for junior developers, providing assistance where needed
Handle smaller projects completely, including interactions with other teams and 3rd parties for design and architecture
Involvement with senior management in terms of supplying input for key design and architecture decisions, as well as work estimation and resource planning

positions.title: Sr. E-Commerce Java Engineer
positions.description:
Analyzed requirements, designed, implemented and tested functionality for a large retail e-commerce web site.   Improved user experience by adding frontend features with JSPs, JSTL, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.   Integrated with backend inventory, order, and customer management systems and with third-party providers via web services (SOAP and REST) coded in Java, MQ/JMS messages, and legacy csv files, shell scripts, and stored procedures.   

Improved the process of balancing inventory levels between the inventory system of record, WM,  and IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS).   Messaging setup for a new inbound message from WM to balance inventory for a single item in WCS in real time to improve on the nightly balancing process.   Setup the MQ queues and the JMS settings in the WCS administration console and WCS mappings of XPath to Java commands.   Used JDBC, EJBs, SQL with DB2.

Increased usability of the online appointment experience by integrating calls to TimeTrade’s web servce API.   Used jQuery to make AJAX calls to web services to minimize the amount of data returned from TimeTrade.   Modified the designer’s frontend JSP to add JSTL tags and jQuery to work with the calendar and call the web service client commands.  Downloaded and installed the TimeTrade SSL certs on each environment, dev, qa, stage, and production. Modified the Ant build file to build the client jar.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer / Manager
positions.description:
Set the technology direction for a team of 7 web developers by collaboratively creating and documenting standard processes and best practices.  Conduct code reviews, gather business requirements, translate functional requirements into technical requirements. Write code for small and large e-commerce projects.  Work with outsourced providers of infrastructure to get test and production environments setup, submit firewall requests, DNS requests, and purchase secure certificates.

Designed database driven web applications using JSP, JSF, Hibernate, SQL, running on IBM WebSphere Application Server and Oracle database. Analyzed and designed complex web systems integration projects using Java and Web Services on WebSphere, RPG and DB2 on the AS/400.

Analyzed business needs for an online rate/quote/bind application and built HTML/JSP demos of front-end screens to get feedback and bring hidden requirements to the surface.   Used demos and iterative development techniques to minimize development costs by building only what the business needed.

Designed and developed a JSTL template-based website to support unique URLs requested by insurance brokers/agents.  Dynamically retrieved custom content and logos from Oracle database via DAOs and SQL.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained about 30 e-commerce web sites in a marketing production environment.  Designed database driven web applications and delivered on time and under budget using PHP, ASP, JSP, MySQL, MS Access, and Oracle databases.  Researched and implemented new technologies including JSF, Hibernate, fillable PDFs, and site search software.  

Increased site interactivity with rate generators, calculators, quizzes, and polls.  Experienced in full lifecycle web development from requirements gathering, analysis, design, programming, testing, launch, and maintenance.  Promoted to E-Commerce Manager in 2004.

positions.title: HTML Programmer
positions.description: Developed and hosted web sites for small businesses.  Managed a virtual server to host sites and offer POP accounts, email aliases, autoresponders, and traffic reports.

positions.title: Geologist / Hydrogeologist
positions.description: Monitor well installation, water sampling, aquifer testing, groundwater modeling, data analysis, report writing for ennvironmental assessment and remediation projects.
